Detection

Three engines analyze every syllable.

Each call is scored across acoustic, spectral and prosodic dimensions before a single risk figure is produced.

Acoustic Analysis

Pitch, energy, voice quality, micro-prosody.

PASSED

Spectral Analysis

Spectral anomalies, frequency artifacts, synthetic patterns.

PASSED

Prosodic Analysis

Rhythm, intonation, speaking pattern, pauses.

PASSED

Workflow

Detect. Verify. Score. Respond.

01

Detect

Identify AI-generated and manipulated voices in the live audio stream.

02

Verify

Compare the caller's voiceprint against trusted, enrolled speaker profiles.

03

Score

Combine voice integrity, identity match and transaction context into one score.

04

Respond

Trigger the response the risk level calls for — allow, verify or block.

Use Cases

Built for where voice fraud does the most damage.

Banking & Finance

Prevent voice-based fraud during high-value transactions and phone banking.

Enterprise

Protect executives and employees from impersonation and wire-transfer scams.

Telecom & VoIP

Monitor voice integrity continuously across live communication networks.

Government

Strengthen protection against official impersonation in citizen-facing calls.

End Users

Get a timely warning before trusting a suspicious caller with sensitive information.

Real-Time Protection

Instant risk scores and alerts during a live call, not after the fraud is done.

Fraud Prevention

Catch voice cloning before a sensitive action — a transfer, a reset, an approval — is authorized.

Privacy First

Feature-only logging and privacy-preserving inference; raw audio is never retained.

Settings

Detection Sensitivity

How aggressively the engine flags borderline audio.

Real-Time Monitoring

Continuously analyze active calls as they happen.

Automatic Blocking

Block a call automatically when risk crosses Critical.

Speaker Verification

Require a voiceprint match against enrolled profiles.

Risk Threshold

Score above which a call is treated as high risk.

Alert Notifications

Send an alert to the security team on Critical threats.

Privacy Mode

Store detection features only — never raw audio.
